summary: Exhaustive frontend audit of BAFFE ROYALE V19.1 across 3 viewports (iPhone 390x844, iPad 768x1024, Desktop 1920x1080). All 5 pages render correctly (/, /roster, /collection, /versus, /zone-debile). BreakingTicker present on all pages with proper overflow:hidden. ScrollToTop verified. Konami code triggers MODE TARPIN with hue-rotate(280deg) on <html>. Game flow validates (countdown -> charge/release -> result screen with DING DING DING + PARTAGER MON HUMILIATION + REJOUER + DÉFIER). 15 roster characters and 16 achievements/trophies confirmed. No horizontal body scroll on any viewport. Zero JS pageerrors / console errors. Critical issue: cookie banner overlays the BAFFE-MOI slap button on mobile Game page (and result-screen submit area) when the user hasn't accepted cookies BEFORE clicking play — element-at-point check confirms cookie banner text is on top of slap-button center, blocking gameplay.

ui_bugs.issue:
On mobile (390px), when the cookie banner has not been dismissed and the user clicks JOUER MAINTENANT, the cookie banner stays fixed at the bottom and completely covers the BAFFE-MOI slap-button (gap from viewport = 80px, banner height ~280px). elementFromPoint on the slap-button center returns the cookie banner

, not the slap-button. User cannot play until cookies dismissed.
Same overlay also covers the bottom area of ResultScreen on mobile (submit-score-btn / share-defeat-twitter / challenge-friend-btn / replay-btn / home-btn region) when cookies haven't been accepted.

ACCEPTER / REFUSER buttons in the FIRST cookie banner instance (Home) have NO data-testid (the test could only find them by text). However on the /game ResultScreen the cookie banner exposes data-testid='cookie-banner-accept' / 'cookie-banner-refuse'. Inconsistent testids between two CookieBanner instances suggests possibly TWO CookieBanner components mounted (potential duplicate).
data-testid is 'quit-btn' (not 'quit-button' as suggested in the review spec). Functional but inconsistent with naming convention used elsewhere (back-btn, play-button).

issues: All 15 character cards render correctly with stats, bio, taunt — no truncation observed.
LOOTS/SKINS/TROPHÉES tabs all switch correctly. MAINS DE FEU shows black-on-yellow good contrast, TIR FUSIL shows black-on-orange good contrast — readability OK.
CHOISIS TES DEUX ABRUTIS title displays correctly (h2 below VERSUS h1). All elements visible — no overflow.
100% ABSURDITÉ title visible, compteur, tweet, rumeur, fait inutile, prophétie all render — humor intact (le site reste stupide).
Grade card shows large letter (e.g., 'D' with 💩 corner emoji) but no literal 'Grade' label text — relies on visual hierarchy. Acceptable design but could be ambiguous to test.

action_items: FIX HIGH: Either hide the CookieBanner on /game (and on ResultScreen) until the user has interacted with it, OR auto-dismiss/auto-collapse it once gameplay starts, OR lower its z-index so the slap-button (and result CTAs) sit above it. Currently on mobile (390px) the banner blocks the BAFFE-MOI button entirely.

FIX MEDIUM: Check if CookieBanner is mounted twice (once globally in App.js and once inside ResultScreen/Game). Only one instance should exist and it should expose consistent data-testid='cookie-banner-accept' / 'cookie-banner-refuse' attributes.
FIX LOW: Rename data-testid='quit-btn' to 'quit-button' for consistency with review spec, OR update doc to reference 'quit-btn'.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='daily-modifier-badge' (carried over from iteration 2).
critical_code_review_comments: CookieBanner z-index/positioning: the banner is rendered with fixed positioning over content on all routes. On /game the slap-button is the primary interactive element near the bottom — these two must never collide. Suggest adding a CSS rule or conditional render to hide CookieBanner while location.pathname === '/game' (or while !cookieAccepted, dim the play button to force user to accept first).

Potential double-mount of CookieBanner: on Home initial render the ACCEPTER button has no testid, but on /game ResultScreen the same banner exposes data-testid='cookie-banner-accept'. Indicates either (a) two CookieBanner components in the tree, or (b) the testid is conditionally applied. Both cases warrant review.

Konami detection works via document keydown listener (case-insensitive on b/a). MODE TARPIN message + hue-rotate(280deg) saturate(1.4) applied to <html> element — clean implementation. Confirmed 8s duration not measured but visual effect activates.
BreakingTicker uses CSS marquee animation; container has overflow-x:hidden so no body scroll. Animation duration appropriate, content readable.
ScrollToTop component works correctly — scrollY resets to 0 on route change verified (Roster scrollY=1000 -> Home scrollY=0).

success_rate.frontend: ~88% — all rendering & navigation correct; 2 HIGH overlay bugs related to CookieBanner blocking interactions

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Cookie banner z-index/overlay issue is the only critical blocker. To reproduce: set viewport 390x844, navigate to /, do NOT click ACCEPTER, click data-testid='play-button', wait 5s for countdown, then run document.elementFromPoint(slap.center.x, slap.center.y) — returns the cookie

, not the slap-button. Same situation on /game ResultScreen. Available testids on home: skip-link, home-page, toggle-voice-btn, nav-leaderboard-btn, breaking-ticker, game-title, play-button, daily-button, practice-button, versus-button, lottery-wheel, lottery-spin-btn, escalade-widget, portal-roster, portal-collection, portal-debile, play-button-bottom, site-footer, compliance-panel. On game: game-score, game-combo, quit-btn (NOT quit-button), slap-button. On result-screen: result-screen, grade, result-score, result-kos, result-combo, result-perfects, rank-display, pseudo-input, submit-score-btn, download-card-btn, share-defeat-twitter, challenge-friend-btn, replay-btn, home-btn, cookie-banner, cookie-banner-accept, cookie-banner-refuse. Roster testids: roster-card-{id}. Konami code (↑↑↓↓←→←→ba) works on desktop and triggers MODE TARPIN.
rca of the issue: CookieBanner is rendered as a fixed-positioned element at the bottom of viewport with high z-index, persisting across all routes (including /game). The slap-button on Game page is positioned at bottom: 80px (5rem / safe-area-inset-bottom + 1rem) which sits within the cookie banner's vertical footprint (~280px). Without an early-exit/hide for /game route, the banner intercepts pointer events on the slap-button. Mitigation options: (1) hide CookieBanner during gameplay routes, (2) auto-accept (default essential) and move banner to a non-blocking toast, (3) raise slap-button z-index above banner AND adjust banner to not intercept clicks outside its actual area.
